name: Passing Word of a Threat
summary: Advisor Belgrum has read Historian Karnik's note and sends you back to Karnik with a message spoken on the king's authority: act on what is known, swiftly and decisively, and halt the Shadowforge's doings in the Badlands.

sections.title: Belgrum's Answer
sections.body: Belgrum reads to the end of the note with widening eyes and calls the tidings evil. You are to return to Karnik and relay, on the king's authority, that the information must be acted on quickly and decisively. The Shadowforge's activities in the Badlands have to stop.

sections.title: Karnik's Reply
sections.body: Karnik takes the urgency as the king's own and has a plan ready: the Shadowforge in Uldaman can be slowed by a blow against Angor Fortress, from which they run their operations.

faq.q: Who sends you back to Karnik?
faq.answer: Advisor Belgrum, after reading Karnik's note. You carry a message on the king's authority to act swiftly and decisively.

faq.q: What does Belgrum want done about the Shadowforge?
faq.answer: Belgrum wants Karnik to act quickly and firmly, and to put an end to what the Shadowforge are doing in the Badlands.

aliases: quest before passing word of a threat
faq.answer: You brought Karnik's sealed note to Advisor Belgrum in the earlier Passing Word of a Threat, which followed the Prospect of Faith steps.
